scope: 112 gold-bearing documents of the RAG-HPO CSC corpus
extraction: two output specifications of one instruction-tuned LLM, merged as a phrase union
candidate_source: SapBERT dense index over HPO labels and synonyms
short_circuit: deterministic equality-family rules inside each phrase's own candidate block; runs first and settles rule hits with no LLM call
selection: source-sentence-injected constrained choice over the remaining phrases, one code or abstain per phrase
main_metric: normalized (collapsed) strict matching, per-document macro precision, recall and F1; protocol of paper Tables 3-5

release_cross_check.metric: strict exact matching, corpus-level micro precision, recall and F1
